18:58 Local Time, 17:58 GMT, 23:28 IST: Chasing a huge target of 344 runs, Ireland were never really in the game right from the start. Their openers played too carefully, which allowed the required run rate to keep climbing. Most of the Irish batters either struggled to score quickly or gave away their wickets just as they got going. Andy Balbirnie fought hard, but wasn't enough for Ireland. However, when Rashid Khan got him out, Ireland's hopes completely died with 129 runs still needed from 59 balls. Rashid was brilliant with the ball, finishing his 10 overs with figures of 3 for 49. Right after finishing his bowling spell, Rashid made another imapct in the game by taking an amazing one handed catch at cover to dismiss Mark Adair.

Curtis Campher gave Ireland a tiny bit of hope near the end with a fiery knock. He reached his fifty off just 34 balls and went on to score 84 off 46 deliveries. His brilliant hitting brought the equation down to 51 runs needed off the last 18 balls. But once Campher was caught at covers the fight was over, and Ireland finished their innings on 301.
